rule.name: Android Cleartext Traffic Enabled
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a transport-security exception, insecure endpoint, or certificate-validation configuration. Resolve the effective policy and the connections it governs.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker on the network may read or alter affected traffic if sensitive data travels over cleartext or the connection accepts an untrusted server. Normal HTTPS endpoints and correctly implemented validation do not establish exposure.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS with normal certificate-chain and hostname verification. Remove permissive production callbacks and broad transport exceptions; restrict any justified exception to a documented, non-sensitive endpoint.
rule.reviewer: Review AndroidManifest and network security config for cleartext allowances. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android Backup Allowed
rule.rule_desc: Application backup or restore is permitted. Resolve the effective inclusion rules, platform behavior, encryption, and stored data sensitivity.
rule.vuln_desc: Private records or credentials may become accessible through an insufficiently protected backup or transfer destination. The presence of a backup flag alone does not prove that sensitive files are included.
rule.developer: Exclude non-transferable secrets from backup and verify cloud and device-transfer policies. Protect required backups with suitable encryption, access controls, and tested recovery procedures.
rule.reviewer: Validate backup policy for apps handling sensitive data. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android Debuggable Build Flag
rule.rule_desc: A configuration or API enables development diagnostics, process inspection, or debugging. Verify whether it applies to a deployed production artifact.
rule.vuln_desc: An actor with access to an enabled debugging interface may inspect private state or influence application execution; exposed development endpoints may disclose internal implementation details.
rule.developer: Disable debugging and development endpoints in production, bind necessary diagnostic services to restricted interfaces, and verify the final deployed artifact and access policy.
rule.reviewer: Verify manifest and Gradle build types for release-safe values. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android WebView JavaScript Enabled
rule.rule_desc: The application renders web content, executes scripts, or exposes a native messaging interface. Resolve navigation trust, origin isolation, and validation at the native boundary.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled web content may execute in a trusted context or invoke native operations, exposing session data or application privileges when isolation and per-operation checks are insufficient.
rule.developer: Restrict navigation and message origins to required trusted sources. Avoid dynamic script construction, minimize native bridge methods, validate message inputs, and authorize sensitive native operations.
rule.reviewer: Audit WebView content origins and bridge exposure. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android WebView File URL Universal Access
rule.rule_desc: The application renders web content, executes scripts, or exposes a native messaging interface. Resolve navigation trust, origin isolation, and validation at the native boundary.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled web content may execute in a trusted context or invoke native operations, exposing session data or application privileges when isolation and per-operation checks are insufficient.
rule.developer: Restrict navigation and message origins to required trusted sources. Avoid dynamic script construction, minimize native bridge methods, validate message inputs, and authorize sensitive native operations.
rule.reviewer: Verify WebView file access settings are hardened. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android JavaScript Interface Exposure
rule.rule_desc: The application exposes script execution or a native interface to rendered web content. Resolve the content source and effective origin restrictions.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled content may execute in a trusted page or invoke native operations, exposing application data or privileges when origin isolation and operation authorization are insufficient.
rule.developer: Restrict loaded origins, avoid interpolating untrusted data into scripts, and expose only required native operations with input validation and per-operation authorization.
rule.reviewer: Review annotated bridge methods and content trust boundaries. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Android Hardcoded Secret Marker
rule.rule_desc: The checked source or build configuration embeds potentially sensitive credential or key material. Determine whether it is active and whether it reaches distributed artifacts or logs.
rule.vuln_desc: A party who can read exposed source, artifacts, configuration, or logs may recover active secrets and access the protected service or decrypt data with the secret owner’s privileges.
rule.developer: Remove active secrets from source and build layers, rotate exposed values, and load replacements through a restricted secret-management facility. Use narrowly privileged, short-lived credentials.
rule.reviewer: Validate no production secrets are embedded in mobile clients. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
